decisions.reason: The in-ear earmold fits the firm's core hearing-care competence and certified digital production, so it costs little to carry in a growing industry, although its thin website presence leaves some risk that it gets folded into the broader earmold range.

The EARsleeve has its own page, serves a clear need for universal in-ear hearing systems, and builds on core earmold know-how, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The vacuum thermoforming unit anchors the integrated dental material-and-device system, so dropping it would gain little and would endanger sales of the consumables used with it.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and its results are still uncertain, but it has its own page, is only one year on the market, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm give this diversification into digital custom manufacturing more time before judging it against aspirations.
The post-curing unit completes the firm's digital 3D-printing workflow for resins, so it supports system sales at low incremental cost and is likely to be retained.
